spans.s:
f. (-षा)
A woman.
E.
युष to serve, Sautra root, causal form, aff. अच् and टाप्.

f. (-षित्)
A woman in general.
E.
युष Sautra root, to serve, to worship, to hurt, इति Uṇādi aff.; also with टाप् added योषिता f. (-ता.)

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Done by a woman, contracted by her, &c.
E.
योषित्, and कृत done.
